teaches: the vocalized سَوْفَ is a closed-registry future-marker member; the class label carries no case, mood or governor
the ordinary unpointed سوف is registered as an EXACT surface form of the same future-marker member, not a normalization of سَوْفَ
لقد is registered separately from bare قد; the registry is closed and exact
no evidence at all never survives as a default nongoverning class
without a declared verb tense no closed-registry member is licensed, سوف included
لن genuinely governs the subjunctive; it is deliberately outside this closed registry and never resolved here
لم genuinely governs the jussive; a hostile near-collision surface never borrows a nongoverning class
cross-pack hostile: bare قد before a perfect verb is owned exclusively by inc-qad-tense-conditioned-sense; this registry never resolves it even though the tense evidence is present
cross-pack hostile: the other tense-conditioned bare-قد reading is also owned exclusively by inc-qad-tense-conditioned-sense, never duplicated here
a near-miss surface with an extra letter is never promoted from mere similarity to the registered سوف form
an altered vocalization that is neither registered exact form (سَوْفَ nor سوف) is never promoted from surface similarity
